findings.trigger: Positive Peek followed by another alias consuming available bytes and writer closure can complete ReadFile as EOF; once published, a subsequent pause sees Complete(Eof) and returns Clear.
findings.impact: The per-operation positive/Reading observation is lost between native completion and relay consumption. stop(false) may classify the unconsumed Read-started result as preserved-tool, contrary to the specified observed-input terminal boundary.
findings.minimalResolution: Keep origin/observed state in the completed result, or classify read-started EOF separately as Dirty while retaining its actual EOF meaning for normal consumption. Do not turn cancellation into NoData.
findings.targetedCounterexample: Positive Peek, alias consumption and writer close, Read EOF, completion publication, then stop; assert terminal classification. Test a successful Peek0 separately for Clear.
